messages:
ari (CS): Heads-up 9 — Atlas goes live tomorrow AM. Account marked 'watch' for renewal. Can we produce a tiny customer-facing mini-manual (one page) for the first 48h: prefill/warmup checklist, batching guidance by prompt length, streaming quick checks, a 2-question feedback ping, and a 3-line smoke test they can run? Who can take this?
ben_cs: I will draft. Aim: very short, bulleted, clear 'do this now' checklist + an 'engineer note' with the curl smoke test. Need eng to confirm expected metrics.
raj (eng-runtime): I got you. Minimal smoke test we recommend: 1) run 12 quick warmup calls to prime KV/tokenizer; 2) send 25 streamed requests spaced ~150-200ms; 3) confirm first chunk latency <1.5s and KV hit rate >80%. If those pass, team is unlikely to hit cold-start churn. I'll provide a paste-ready curl.
maya-support: Add escalation thresholds: errors >2% over 5m OR median generation latency >2s -> open urgent ticket and include trace_id + sample prompts. Feedback webhook will auto-create a ticket.
prewarm-bot: Note: Atlas dedicated pool prewarm scheduled tonight 22:45 UTC.
ben_cs: Customer checklist (draft bullets): 1) Run prefill script (12 requests) 2) Apply batching heuristic: short (<150 tokens) -> batch=32; medium (150-512) -> batch=8-16; long (>512) -> batch=4-8 3) Run smoke test and confirm streaming chunks appear quickly 4) Submit 2-question feedback (Yes/No + short note) after first 24h.
raj (eng-runtime): Engineer note / shareable curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
Expect: HTTP 200, first stream chunk <=1500ms, KV hit rate >80% after warmup. If KV stays low, increase prefill_count to 30 or widen TTL. If streaming chunks delayed, switch to non-streaming endpoint and capture trace_id.
maya-support: Feedback form (2 Qs): Q1 "Were results useful?" (Yes/No). Q2 "If no, brief note". Hook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/atlas-feedback -> creates ticket tagged onboard/atlas.
ben_cs: I'll create the one-pager PDF + plain-text snippet and post to #customer-success + DM Atlas CSM by EOD. Include a tiny triage table for the customer and a line that says what we'll check on our side (KV priming, pool health, recent deploys).
ari (CS): Perfect. Keep language simple for customers, but include the engineer note for dev teams. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
